Ongoing PBM studies

A searchable, password-protected pilot assembled from clinical-trial registry searches.

i

Initial pilot snapshot. The 489 displayed records were returned by three broad WHO ICTRP searches and selected by keyword rules. A separate 50-record stratified audit found 37 in scope, 9 unresolved and 4 out of scope; it did not review every displayed record. In the imported export, these records were reported as recruiting, so that is the only status currently available in the filter. Another 1,651 candidates are labeled only “Not Recruiting”; that does not show whether a trial is still active, completed or terminated, so they are held until the original registry can clarify. Status and PBM relevance may have changed or be misclassified; check the linked registry before relying on a record. Direct searches in original registries are being tested and are not yet fully incorporated.

    i

    This pilot reproduces selected registry metadata from WHO ICTRP for non-commercial research use. Source-reported status and record-update dates can lag behind reality; confirm every study in its linked registry. The date of this search, the ICTRP processing date when supplied, and provider import dates are distinct. The ICTRP processing date was not included in this export, so this snapshot is for private testing and is not cleared for wider distribution yet. PBM.science is independent and is not endorsed by WHO. The page is password-protected and excluded from search indexing.
